output.interpretation: A vendor API notice states the field-dispatch v2 route endpoint was retired on 2026-10-01 and route pushes must now use v3. This is an infrastructure/API-version constraint on how the push_route_update protected action would be executed; it is not evidence about the cause of the billing dispute surge and does not touch any of the dispute-cause hypotheses or premises.

contradiction_assessment.rationale: The notice only changes the technical mechanism (API version) for executing push_route_update under K-DISPATCH; it does not affect the billing-dispute causal premises (E-01..E-08, E-12) or SD-1's current remedies, none of which currently invoke push_route_update.

vob_proposals.validation_method: Verify the field-dispatch tool call targets the v3 route endpoint prior to invoking push_route_update, given field-dispatch tool_health is currently UNKNOWN.

field-dispatch tool_health check succeeding post-v3 switch
